user.title: Create a limited dashboard
user.description: Choose the dashboard name and the short name used in its web address.

data_description.slug: Use a short name such as landscaper, child, or rental-guest.

account.title: Create the guest sign-in
account.description: These credentials are separate from Home Assistant accounts.

cards.title: Choose dashboard cards
cards.description: Add entities from {entity_type}. Selected entities stay on the dashboard when you change types. Remove or reorder them in Selected entities. Choose where approved entities appear in the owner appearance editor after saving. New entities are listed as Approved entities not placed until you add their cards.

data.choose_another_type: Add another entity type before continuing

schedule.title: Choose when access works
schedule.description: Leave this on for access at any time. Turn it off and press Submit to choose allowed weekdays and hours.

sprinklers.title: Timed sprinkler controls
sprinklers.description: The selected Rachio zones use timed watering. Choose their run time; they cannot be started as ordinary switches.

entity_filter.description: Choose a type to narrow the list. You can add more types without losing your selections. Plugs are switches marked as outlets in Home Assistant; other plugs are under Switches.
entity_filter.title: Find entities by type

share.title: Your dashboard link

schedule_window.description: Access is limited to these weekdays and times.
schedule_window.title: Choose allowed days and hours

appearance.title: Choose dashboard appearance
appearance.description: Choose a starting layout and colors. These owner settings work even when guest customization is off. After saving, the final screen links to the full appearance editor for tabs, sections and individual cards.

data_description.accent: Enter a six-digit color such as #03a9f4.

error.invalid_slug: Enter a valid web address name.
error.invalid_username: The username must contain between 3 and 64 characters.
error.password_too_short: Use a password with at least 12 characters. A longer passphrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.
error.slug_in_use: Another dashboard already uses this web address name.
error.unsupported_entity: This entity type is not supported.
error.unsupported_irrigation: Choose individual Rachio zone switches, not controller, rain-delay, hose timer, or schedule switches.
error.password_too_long: Use a password with at most 256 characters.
error.invalid_appearance: Choose a valid layout and a six-digit hex accent color, such as #03a9f4.

abort.already_configured: A dashboard with this web address already exists.
abort.invalid_import: The existing YAML configuration could not be imported.
abort.owner_required: Only the Home Assistant owner can configure this dashboard.

init.title: Dashboard details
init.description:
[Edit appearance]({editor_url}) — change tabs, sections, cards and colors as the HA owner, even when guest customization is off.

[Open guest dashboard]({dashboard_url}) — this is the link to share with guests. Change its name or address below. After adding approved entities, save Configure, then use Edit appearance to place them on a tab. Approval alone does not add a visible card.
